tasks.description: [Nova] Implement FEATURE-027-F: Codex CLI Adapter. Add codex (OpenAI Codex CLI) as 4th CLI adapter: YAML registry entry (x-ipe-docs/config + src resources, both must stay in sync due to wheel force-include), AUTO_DETECT_PRIORITY, verbatim skill translation to .codex/skills/, AGENTS.md instructions, MCP deployment via codex mcp add subprocess in init/upgrade flows, update tests (test_cli_adapter count 3->4, new codex cases) and README multi-CLI docs.
[Nova] Acceptance testing for FEATURE-027-F Codex CLI Adapter. Classify ACs by test type, generate acceptance-test-cases.md, execute via enabled tools, report results.
[Nova] Close FEATURE-027-F Codex CLI Adapter: verify ACs, code-to-docs review, refactoring analysis, commit and push to main (main-branch-only), then PyPI release per user request

[Nova] x-ipe 1.1.51 init --cli codex fails with Unknown CLI in projects initialized by older versions: project-scaffolded x-ipe-docs/config/cli-adapters.yaml fully overrides the bundled registry, freezing adapters at init-time. Fix: bundled registry as base + per-adapter project override.
